{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Check if any refunded orders exist
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded))

# Check the structure of the data
print("Shape of df:", df.shape)
print("Unique values in channel:", df['channel'].unique())"}
